title: Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency: Rate Difference for Days in a Cheaper Room before Conversion
content:
**Tier pricing note, cheaper-room days — Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency.** The moved-day rate of the conversion credit — the amount per day given back for nights the resident spent in a cheaper room before the conversion while the advance billed the dearer one — follows the room the resident moved into, the resident never paying the dearer room for nights spent in the cheaper one. Rates are those of the current private pay schedule.

- No isolation placement, and the agreement's tier's current daily rate lower than that of the tier the charge was posted for: the difference between the two.
- An isolation placement, and the isolation billing tier's current daily rate lower than that of the tier the charge was posted for: that difference.
- Otherwise: no moved-day rate.

| Accommodation tier | Current schedule (effective 1 July 2026), USD per day |
|---|---|
| Semi-Private Long-Term Care Room | 398.00 |
| Semi-Private Secure Memory Care Room | 427.00 |
| Private Long-Term Care Room | 436.00 |
| Private Secure Memory Care Room | 465.00 |
| Private Bariatric Care Room | 482.00 |
| Private Suite with Sitting Area | 514.00 |

**Hypothetical case.** A charge posted for the Private Suite with Sitting Area (514.00), the resident now in the Private Long-Term Care Room (436.00), no isolation placement: 78.00 a day. Moving to a dearer tier gives no moved-day rate.
